metadata.description: Claude Code plugin for Worktrunk, a CLI for Git worktree management

plugins.name: worktrunk
plugins.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. This plugin provides configuration guidance (LLM commit messages, project hooks, worktree paths), automatic activity tracking (🤖/💬 indicators in `wt list` showing active Claude sessions), and a `/wt-diff` pane showing each worktree's changes.
